segments.title: Cold Open & Post-Election Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour sign-on; Case Blackwell opens the post-election broadcast declaring 'No Breaks November' and reflecting on the refractory period after election night.

segments.title: Election Post-Game Coverage
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple review post-election statements: Trump press conference, Chuck Schumer clips, Sam Cedar reaction, Texas Senator-elect Teleriko, and Hailey Stevens' long concession tweet. Interwoven with Kendall's allergy test reveal.

segments.title: Hype Train Freestyles on Hailey Stevens
segments.notes: Hype Train interrupts with a high-tempo freestyle about Michigan Rep. Haley Stevens and her fiancé Jason 'Turkish', pivoting to explicit sexual imagery before Jeff Ripple thanks subscribers in 80s synthwave spoken word.

segments.title: Late Election Results & Prop 40
segments.notes: Coverage of Abdulrahman Mohammad Sayyid's victory speech, Nithya Rahman's LA mayoral win, and California Proposition 40 (billionaire tax) trending toward defeat with 61% reporting.

segments.title: Debate: Did Crum Lose Money Betting the Election?
segments.notes: Munch and Crum clash over Crum's Kalshi election wagers; Crum downplays losses as hobby variance, Munch and chat vote that Crum went deeper into debt. Harry Harding raid interrupts with custom song.

segments.title: How To Freestyle & Crip Walk
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget hosts a sickly freestyle tutorial using the 'ripple technique,' attempts a sausage-themed freestyle, then watches a Crip Walk instructional video and plays the name-backwards game with chat.

segments.title: Encircled: Injured Senator vs. 30 Coyotes
segments.notes: Clive Clifton (injured right-wing senator, pinky toe) defends 'America needs more injuries' against a rotating gallery of chat challengers; rambles through healthcare anecdotes, coyote/women equivalence, and anti-marriage platform before time expires.

segments.title: DJ Newsic Musical Close & Raid
segments.notes: DJ Newsic sings the news including West Hollywood's polyamory domestic partnership registry; Clive Clifton returns for a rap verse against marriage; stream ends with raid to Ovali May and Kickstarter plug for 13 Freak Street.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the cold-open sign-on and declares 'No Breaks November' live.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors post-election coverage, moderates Munch & Crum debate, and oversees No Breaks November schedule.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosts election post-game, reads viewer reactions, and delivers 80s synthwave sub thank-yous.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walks through with allergy test results revealing sesame, blueberry, watermelon, mustard, shellfish, and squash allergies.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Derails into explicit freestyle about Rep. Haley Stevens and her fiancé before Jeff Ripple acknowledges subs.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Skeleton Munch debates Crum's election betting losses and confirms permanent skeletal form.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defends Kalshi election wagers as hobby variance; chat and Munch vote he went deeper into debt.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosts How To segment while nauseous from hype overload; attempts freestyle tutorial and Crip Walk lesson.

storylines.beat: [09:04] Case declares 'No Breaks November' — streaming all month with only Sundays off; confirms at [53:12] it started Monday.
[1:14:05] Crum references Kalshi election betting (not traditional sportsbooks) while downplaying losses; Munch and chat vote he went deeper into debt.

lore_notes.fact: Declares No Breaks November (streaming daily except Sundays) starting Monday, November 2.
Allergy test reveals allergies to sesame seeds, blueberries, watermelon, mustard, scallops, shrimp, lima beans, summer squash, and allmans.
Confirms permanent skeleton form: 'this bone structure is never scared away.'
Uses Kalshi prediction markets for election betting, not traditional sportsbooks; claims losses are minimal variance.
Has a custom raid song produced by the network.
True name revealed as Jeb; 'Nogget' is a surname; father's spirit resides in a wooden board (referenced but not on-screen).

episode_summary: Barely Informed News returns for a post-election broadcast under 'No Breaks November,' covering Democratic wins, JD Vance's long-form tweets, and Hailey Stevens' concession thread. Kendall's allergy panel derails the news desk, Hype Train delivers an explicit freestyle about Rep. Haley Stevens, and Munch & Crum debate Crum's Kalshi election losses. Jeb Nogget hosts a nauseous How To segment on freestyling and Crip Walking, then Clive Clifton defends 'America needs more injuries' in Encircled. DJ Newsic closes with a musical summary of West Hollywood's polyamory registry and raids Ovali May.
